plugins.name: render
plugins.description: Skills for working with Render.com - create and validate Render Blueprints (render.yaml) and use the Render CLI for deployments, database access, and service management

plugins.name: rails-api-backend
plugins.description: Rails API backend authoring: routes/migrations/conventions skills, a rails-backend subagent, PostToolUse rubocop hook, and a dev-log monitor.

plugins.name: plugin-auditor
plugins.description: Read-only auditor: fans out four parallel subagents to score skills, agents, hooks, and monitors against live docs, writes a prioritised plan to <plugin>/.claude/reviews/, and proposes bold new components. Never edits plugin files.

plugins.name: react-vite-stack
plugins.description: Opinionated stack: pnpm + Vite + React + TS + TanStack (Router/Query/Form) + Zod + Zustand + shadcn/ui + Tailwind + Clerk + Vitest/RTL + Playwright

plugins.name: monorepo
plugins.description: Orchestration plugin for monorepos with a frontend/ + website/ + backends/<name>/ layout, a central Taskfile.yaml, and cocogito-based versioning. Handles the monorepo layer: cross-package tasks, conventional commits, releases, and Claude memory hygiene.

plugins.name: python-uv-project
plugins.description: Opinionated Python uv development environment: ruff auto-format/lint, pytest with coverage gating, bandit security scanning, Pyright LSP integration, and dep auditing — all via PostToolUse hooks.
